preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must hold xenoX tokens that can be drained

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the transferTokens function with the recipient address set to the attacker's address and the amount set to the contract's full token balance (query balanceOf(address(this)) first). This will transfer all tokens held by the contract to the attacker, draining the contract's token reserves.
